priorArtDiagnosis: wt/turn-freeze 2f8080585 bent the walked path into a circular arc defined by start point + start tangent + end point. Reconstructed from the live SC-05 intent: with zero bias the construction is degenerate (target lies exactly on the start-tangent line, infinite radius, the straight line); with the shipped 0.02 bias the circle has radius 29.4 m and delivers 1.27 deg of the required 63.63 deg, leaving 62.36 deg residual (measured then: 61.6 vs 62.3 deg). A 10x bias increase (0.1) still delivers only 6.36 deg. An arc pinned by start point + start tangent + end point has its END TANGENT fixed by that geometry, not by the target facing, so the arrival heading is unconstrained and the residual turn cannot shrink. Confirmed, not refuted.
verdictReason: No end-heading-constrained curve fits this room inside the gait yaw budget: at R_MIN 1.32 m the shortest closing Dubins path is a 4.15 m loop deviating 1.21 m laterally through the stretcher (0.234 m overlap); the only compact violation-free fit (R 0.5 m, 1.46 m) demands 79 deg footfall pivots, 2.6x over budget. Pushback (C1) loops worse; facing-ray waypoint (C2) replaces the 63.6 deg turn with an 86-110 deg corner. No runtime code changed; control rows stand as the known-good column.
